product_family: Stable Audio (Stability AI's generative audio model family, currently Stable Audio 3.0), offered as open-weight downloads, a consumer web app (StableAudio.com), an enterprise Brand Studio product, a Platform API, and a Self-Hosted License; part of the wider Stability AI portfolio (image, video, 3D, audio models).

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or BAA availability. Stability AI's Terms of Service instruct users not to input sensitive personal information including 'health information', which points away from HIPAA-covered use.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence: not listed among the trust center's Compliance or Security Frameworks entries.

privacy.ai_training_note: Training is on by default with an opt-out, and the default differs by input type. Per the vendor's own Privacy Center: for Stable Audio, uploaded audio itself is not used for training, but the generated audio outputs from user interactions may be used to improve/train the model unless the user disables 'Training: Improve the Model for Everyone' in account settings at StableAudio.com. The same opt-out pattern is offered across Brand Studio, Platform API, and Stable Assistant, each with its own settings toggle. Enterprise/Self-Hosted License customers get full control over their data per the vendor's enterprise materials.
privacy.data_region: Not specified on vendor pages. Production infrastructure and the HPC training cluster are hosted on Amazon Web Services per the trust center subprocessor list; no specific data-residency region (e.g. EU-only hosting) is disclosed for Stable Audio.

security.name: Independent SOC 2 Type 2 audit
security.value: Report available to prospects/customers via the trust center portal (request access required)

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure Program
security.value: Public VDP with a dedicated reporting page and security@stability.ai contact

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Third-party penetration testing performed; a 2025 Penetration Test Executive Report is published in the trust center resource library

security.name: Subprocessors disclosed
security.value: Named subprocessors include AWS (cloud hosting/HPC), Thorn (CSAM dataset filtering), Cinder (content-policy monitoring), and OpenRouter/Mistral/DeepInfra (only when using the 'AI Enhance Prompt' feature)

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Personal information is generally retained no longer than one year, then deleted or anonymized unless a longer period is legally required

security.name: Copyright / content controls
security.value: Uses Audible Magic content-recognition (ACR) technology on audio uploads to help detect and prevent copyright infringement

products.name: Stable Audio (open weights)
products.data_scope: No account data processed by Stability AI beyond a download; inference runs on the user's own infrastructure.
products.notes: Free to download and run locally; commercial use governed by the Stability AI license terms.

products.name: StableAudio.com (consumer web app)
products.data_scope: Processes user prompts and any uploaded audio; generated outputs may be used for model training unless the user opts out in account settings.
products.notes: Primary product mapped to the aifoxx 'stability-audio' listing.

products.name: Brand Studio
products.data_scope: Enterprise accounts with per-user training opt-out toggle in Settings.
products.notes: Positioned for brand/marketing teams; separate plans/pricing from the consumer app.

products.name: Platform API
products.category: Developer API access to Stability models
products.data_scope: Inputs/outputs sent via API; training opt-out available at platform.stability.ai/account/overview.
products.notes: Used by third-party developers integrating Stable Audio generation into their own products.

products.name: Self-Hosted License / Enterprise
products.data_scope: Full customer control; models deployed in customer-controlled environment, no data leaves customer infrastructure.
products.notes: Includes legal indemnification under Stability AI's Enterprise license, per vendor marketing copy.

compare.pricing_model: Free open-weight download; paid consumer/creator plans on StableAudio.com; usage-based Platform API; custom enterprise pricing for Brand Studio and Self-Hosted License (includes indemnification)
compare.data_residency: Not disclosed; primary infrastructure on AWS with no stated region guarantee for the hosted consumer/API products (self-hosted deployments run entirely in the customer's own environment)

flags: The captured trust center content lists SOC 2 Type 2 only; no ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 42001, or CSA STAR evidence exists anywhere on vendor-owned pages as of this review, despite Stability AI's enterprise-facing marketing (indemnification, Brand Studio, Self-Hosted License). Do not infer these certs from the enterprise positioning alone.
No standalone, publicly linked Data Processing Agreement (DPA) document was found; enterprise customers should confirm DPA availability directly with Stability AI's legal/privacy team.

Training-on-data policy differs by product and by input type (uploaded audio vs. generated output) and is opt-out, not opt-in, by default - flag this nuance in any listing copy so it is not mis-simplified as 'does not train on your data'.
